name: Enhanced Fireball Rune
disable: DC 32 Thievery check (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 27) to counteract the rune

items.name: Fireball
items.text:
Trigger A living creature enters the sensor area

---
Effect The rune detonates a fireball centered on the triggering creature's square. This is a 6th-rank Fireball spell that deals 12d6 fire damage (DC 29 basic Reflex save save).

text: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.
